principles.iconOnlyControls: Every icon-only official control has an explicit accessibilityLabel sourced from OfficialUISpec.Text.
principles.keyboard: Each keyboardOnly official scene retains a visible focusable control and hidden/closed controls cannot receive focus.
principles.systemPreferences: Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency, Increase Contrast, light and dark color schemes preserve readable controls without forced motion.

corePaths.focusContract: New Session and settings are Buttons; collapsed controls are conditionally absent from the wide hierarchy.
Composer TextEditor uses an explicit FocusState binding.
Inspector close control is a Button with an explicit accessible name.
Approval action buttons remain semantic Buttons in the takeover hierarchy.
Question navigation and cancellation remain semantic Buttons while options remain selectable.
The 56px rail exposes only its visible Buttons; custom glass motion is disabled by accessibilityReduceMotion.
